_how_to_use: Photos are found automatically from Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons, and only openly licensed ones (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA) are used. You do not need to add anything here. Use this file only to fix a person: add an entry under 'portraits' keyed by the profile id. Options: 'wikipedia' (a different Wikipedia article title to look up), 'disabled': true (never show a photo), or a manual photo with file/url plus credit, license and source.
